author: Jason Warner and Sofia Romansky
title: The lack of a shared lexicon is undermining responsible AI-military integration
description: We need a common way to talk about military AI—across services, agencies, and indeed, the world.
content:
Todays headlines are full of killer robots and doomsayers, but the most urgent risk in military AI is more mundane: the people shaping it share neither a common lexicon nor common data.
